items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: they had banjos, Charlotte, and the final recording he made was on the Victor recording people

ctx.x: You know, were they playing like that? That sort of thing?

Yeah, well you see, he had, the way it's different coming in them days, they had banjos. You see, in the piano and Piran band, they had banjos, Charlotte, and the final recording he made was on the Victor recording people out in New York. That's one record recording I remember, the Victor recording people, because they had it on demonstration down there at Phillip Weylines.
